column3: “Jesus” makes the subject explicit; the historical present becomes past.
BSB’s “them” matches the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “Him” (αὐτῷ).
The bringing is expressed passively; “Jesus” makes the pronoun explicit.
“Nests” specifies dwelling places; the historical present becomes past.
“Jesus” supplies the subject; “storm” interprets the shaking.
BSB’s “the disciples” and “us” match the Textus Receptus (μαθηταὶ); the critical text has neither.
“What do You want with us” interprets the idiom about us and You.
